title: Ardmore Shipping Exercises Newbuilding Options
summary: Ardmore Shipping Corporation (NYSE: ASC) ("Ardmore" or the "Company") today announced it has exercised the options for a further two 40,500 dwt Handysize product/chemical tankers to be built at Wuhu Shipyard. This expands the original order to six vessels in total on similar terms, and the Company has no further options outstanding. The deliveries of these six vessels are scheduled from late 2028 and onwards.
